beats_proxy.method: existing librosa DP proxy; NOT GT beat labels

gt_calibration.note: GT low/negative margins expose metric calibration limits, not GT dance failure.

protocol.bas_music: mean over music beats of exp(-nearest motion distance^2/(2*sigma^2))
protocol.bas_motion: traditional BAS: mean over motion events of exp(-nearest beat distance^2/(2*sigma^2))
protocol.completeness: complete means all selected source/cache fingerprints validated, NOT metric/human acceptance

scope: Only three fixed source cases per condition, paired deltas and configuration means; Configuration videos are NOT IID. No significance claim, metric tuning, max-lag selection, music-style truth, or automatic human-quality verdict.
